methods.purpose: select any teacher that is actually correct on the sample, not just domain-matched
methods.reject_if: weakest-domain floor or regression vector worsens

methods.name: Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation

methods.reject_if: specialist gain or merge robustness is inferior at matched compute

methods.name: Absolute Zero Reasoner style self-play
methods.purpose: propose and solve self-generated verifiable reasoning/code tasks
methods.reject_if: curriculum saturates, leaks evals, or generated tasks lack learnable information

methods.name: Challenger-Planner-Solver-Critic self-evolution
methods.purpose: generate increasingly difficult verified long-horizon tasks
methods.reject_if: critic drift or verifier failure produces curriculum collapse

methods.name: Self-Play Long-Context Curriculum

methods.reject_if: no gain over matched supervised/CPT baseline

methods.name: RL with Self-Verifiable Rewards
methods.purpose: transform open-ended tasks into verifiable proxy environments
methods.reject_if: proxy reward fails to transfer to real open-ended quality

methods.reject_if: oracle unreliability or reward hacking exceeds outcome baseline

methods.name: Expert Merging++

methods.reject_if: inferior to simple TIES/DARE or regression vector worsens

methods.name: Upcycling Instruction Tuning
methods.purpose: convert diverse dense specialists/intermediate checkpoints into sparse experts
methods.reject_if: router collapse or serving cost outweighs verified gain

methods.name: Nash Merging of Experts
